name: Pancragen
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Pancragen (KEDW) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 20 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 116 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Pancragen tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each KEDW lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (formula C26H36N6O9, 576.60 Da).

faq.question: How should Pancragen be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 116-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this KEDW preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Pancragen?
faq.answer: Pancragen is stocked in 1 pack size (20 mg), 116 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $133.70; 10–49 kits falls to $123.00 (−8%) and 50+ to $113.64 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
